subject: russian
summary: Short comprehension cards with a plain list of answers (6, 7, 9) look good, and every attached page is the right passage. The scheme side is the weak point: many cards open with a block of general examiner instructions meant for markers (square brackets, totting up marks, transferring to a spreadsheet) before any answer appears, and several show internal authoring notes ('approved on 18 November 2026', 'no precedence is invented'). The two guided-writing cards run every option, bullet and sub-part into one unbroken paragraph in both the question and the scheme and are four to five phone screens long. Card 1 prints the same slash-and-plus answer string four times. Five cards show the scheme points in pale grey disabled-looking text until an 'Answer N' button is pressed. Card 12 has no screenshots at all (capture failed).

issues.title: Guided-writing question and scheme flattened into one paragraph
issues.detail: Cards 2 and 3 run the whole of Q3 together: 'ONE of the following... 1. LETTER Write a letter... personal details why you have selected that summer school how you heard about the school 2. NARRATIVE ... OR ... 3. DISCUSSION ...'. On card 2 the bullets are replaced by wide gaps. The scheme then repeats the same flattened task with the category letters inline ('A opening /closing the letter B personal details C why...') twice, once in the intro and again under Communication/content. The official paper lays this out as numbered options with bullet lists, which is far clearer.
issues.suggested_fix: Render the options as headed blocks (1 Letter, 2 Narrative, 3 Discussion) with real bullet lists and 'OR' separators; let the student pick the option they wrote and show only that option's A-F content checklist as tick rows.

issues.title: Marker-only general instructions and author notes shown as the scheme
issues.detail: Card 3 opens with about 40 lines of general marking instructions ('WRITTEN EXAMINATION - 170 MARKS Waivers... Write marks above the material... Transfer the question marks onto the spreadsheet... Decoding the marking scheme'). Cards 1, 5 and 8 open with section-level rules ('SECTION I Comprehension [120 marks] Answer questions 1, 2 and 3...', 'LISTENING COMPREHENSION - 80 marks General:...'). 'Your placement' text is author jargon: card 8 'Two marks per complete requested detail are inferred from the paper's 20-mark section totals and approved on 18 November 2026... The booklet front says 50 minutes and its back says 40 minutes'; cards 2 and 3 'Lower A has a descriptor conflict... no precedence is invented'; card 1 'Do not infer a unique full/partial association from list position'; card 10 'numeric self-scoring is unavailable'; card 11 'Source wording differs...'.
issues.suggested_fix: Cut everything addressed to examiners or content authors. Keep at most one or two student-relevant rules (2 marks per detail, 1 for a partial, answer in English or Irish) as a short note under the answers.

issues.title: Card 1: slash-and-plus answer string printed four times
issues.detail: The whole scheme line '3 × 2 = 6 assign two marks: (there was) everything that one needed (close/near by) + sport complex/ centre / gym / fitness centre / with swimming pool + library + amusement/ leisure centre + lots of shops + skating rink / ice rink / ice-skating (centre) assign one mark: everything no marks:' appears in the intro and again under 'Distinct detail 1', 2 and 3. It is raw examiner shorthand with a dangling 'no marks:' and no separate answers.
issues.suggested_fix: List the accepted details once as separate rows (everything one needed nearby; sports complex with swimming pool; library; leisure centre; lots of shops; ice rink), 'any 3, 2 marks each', with 'everything = 1 mark' as a partial-credit note.

issues.title: Scheme answers shown in pale, disabled-looking text
issues.detail: On cards 4, 5 and 8 the answer rows ('90 000', 'Kolya arrived by motorbike', 'Jeans') are light grey on white with a greyed checkbox until the student presses the 'Answer N' button above each one. They look inactive and are hard to read, especially on a phone. Cards 6 and 7 use dark text with 0m/1m/2m buttons and read much better.
issues.suggested_fix: Show all scheme answers in normal dark text from the moment of reveal; drop the separate 'Answer N' gate button and let the row itself be tappable.

issues.title: 'Select N items' count does not match the list, plus repeated language checkboxes
issues.detail: Card 5 asks for two details but lists 'Answer 1' to 'Answer 6' under 'Select the 2 items you answered'; card 8 lists four for two; cards 6 and 7 list five and four for three. The labels 'Answer 1..6' suggest six required answers. Card 4 says 'Select the 1 items'. 'This answer uses a language other than specified · no credit' is repeated under every row on cards 1, 5 and 9 as well as once for the whole card.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the card 9 heading style ('Any 2 of these — 2 marks each') over one plain list with no 'Answer N' labels, and keep a single language toggle per card.

issues.title: Question text slips
issues.detail: Card 4: the four options are plain lines ('19 000 / 9000 / 90 000 / 99 000') rather than option buttons, with no currency. Card 9: a line break is stuck inside the sentence ('...the morning of that / day.'). Card 1: missing space ('district.Why') and a trailing '(Section 3)' with no explanation. Card 11: '(16 marks)' left in the text. Card 10: the question does not say there are three separate interviews of gaps until the attachment is opened.
issues.suggested_fix: Normalise whitespace, strip mark tallies, render multiple choice as option buttons, and for card 1 say 'see paragraph 3 of the text'.

issues.title: Gap-fill and matching schemes lose their structure
issues.detail: Card 10 lists ten answer words in a flat column with no interview headings or gap numbers, and the first word 'Как' is buried inside an explanatory note box. Card 11 is correct but item c carries an author note and the bottom bar repeats the full Russian headlines. Card 11's attached page also shows the start of sibling part (iii) at the bottom.
issues.suggested_fix: Group card 10 answers under 'Interview 1/2/3' with gap numbers ('1. Как', '2. сколько'...). On card 11 show a simple a-4, b-3, c-2, d-1 table and a one-line student-facing note on heading c.

issues.title: Missing captures and audio
issues.detail: Card 12 (2023 OL Structuring Discourse) has no screenshots at all, so it could not be reviewed. Card 8's audio shows 'could not be loaded'; card 4's audio loaded as the full 37-minute recording with no cue to section 3. Cards 4 and 8 list source pages in the manifest but no attached-page image exists (listening cards).
issues.suggested_fix: Re-capture card 12 and check it by hand; verify listening audio in production and add a start time for the relevant section.
